CHRISTMAS EVENT BATTLE\nDefeat Shawle!!
W-what is this...\nThis room wasn't like this before.
But still, you should at least remember which way\nthe door opens...
Push it and if it doesn't work, push it down.\nThat's what my family taught me.
What a barbarous family...
W-what's that?
M-my lady!
Dunder!
Oops...I can't let you have him yet.
W-what!\nWould you stop it already!
I haven't lost yet...\nIn the name of the anti-Xmas energy, I won't let\nXmas happen...!
Like hell I'll let you!
She's right!
We've prepared so much for it!
I won't let you stop it!
I'll make sure Xmas happens in the city that has\nbeen restored!
Yeah! For sure!
I'll deliver the presents for sure!
For the sake of the treasure! The treasure!
Scuse me, I'm being serious now.
So am I!
So...eventually, what are you gonna do...?
Exactly!\nWhat are you guys here for?!
O-of course to get Dunder back!
Hey, do your job! Go kick his ass, now!
Y-yeah! He was defeated!
We can celebrate Xmas now!!
Dunder! Are you okay?!
Ughh...I can't believe the power of Xmas is\nstill...
That's what you get for messing with me, little\nmidget!
Look who's talking!! Don't call me a midget!\nI'm small because you're too, Velly!
Oh, in other words, you're like Velly's\ncounterpart, that's why you're a midget too...
I said don't call me a midget!\nI didn't want to be like this either...!
Excuse me, could you set me free?
Velly! I'm like this because of you! Do something!
It's not like I enjoy being small either!
Ah, it's fine now.\nI can handle the rest by myself...
You're wrong if you think you've won!\nYou'll pay for this soon!
Ah, he escaped!
Well, isn't it a good thing that he escaped?
More importantly...Go and distribute the presents!\nAnd then gimme my treasure!\nC'mon, c'mon!!
Oh, yeah! Where's Dunder...
Whoa?! Whoaaaaaaaa?!
I'm glad you're finally free now!
Yes. If it wasn't for this powerful person and\nyou, my lady, I wouldn't survive...
Wait, wait!\nNo matter how I look at it, I think it'd have been\nfaster if you were the one who fought.
What amazes me more is the fact that Shawle\nmanaged to catch you...
Not really! This body is only for carrying\npresents for people who have dreams and hopes!
That's right!\nDunder is a nice guy that won't hurt anyone!
W-well...if you say so...
Anyway! Now, you can distribute the presents,\nright? C'mon, hurry up!
Right!\nDunder, hurry up!\nGet the presents and let's go to Navida City!
Sure, my lady!
